title: Drita topple Prizreni to clinch Liga e pare title
description: Drita - Prizreni 92-91 Great defensive blocking was one of the keys in this match when Drita made 7 blocks. 25 personal fouls committed by Prizreni helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. The best player for the winners was Adrian Ibishi who had a double-double by scoring 18 points, 12 rebounds and 4 assists (on 7-of-8 shooting from the field). American guard Jarvis Walker (190, college: IUPUI) chipped in 20 points and 9 rebounds. Rron Dahsyla (193-2005) produced 23 points, 7 rebounds, 9 assists and 4 steals and forward Qendrim Ajazaj (193-1995) added 21 points, 10 rebounds and 4 assists respectively for the guests. Both teams had five players each who scored in double figures.
